summary: Auto Delimiter Dialect Detection + Multi-scale Streaming verification. Backend pytest: 36/36 PASSED (17 core backend + 5 hardening_security + 8 hardening_phase2 + 6 NEW test_csv_dialect: comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, manual override, UTF-8 BOM). Public URL smoke: POST /api/files/detect-dialect returns delimiter/confidence/consistency_score/candidates with Alta/Media/Baja levels and ambiguity_warning; manual_delimiter form param correctly overrides (confidence 1.0, level Alta). POST /api/files/stream-process accepts optional manual_delimiter (Form) and processes semicolon CSV correctly (HTTP 200, normalized comma-CSV output). Frontend Stream CSV (Grandes) tab: uploading a semicolon CSV triggers auto-detection call, shows confidence badge 'Alta (90%)', delimiter 'Punto y coma (;)', encoding UTF-8, consistency 100% (3 columnas), and manual delimiter <select> with 4 options; 'Iniciar Stream Normalización' completes successfully.

issues: Still uses native <input type=file> (Choose File) rather than styled dropzone consistent with home upload area — cosmetic only, carried over from prior iteration.

detect-dialect endpoint is anonymous like stream-process — confirm intentional given file upload cost.
